name: intrst.
tagline: Personalised finance insights and AI-generated visualisations for young adults.

awards: [Warp] Expedited internship / full time interview process + Cash

problem: Young adults lack accessible financial literacy.
solution: Connects accounts and uses Gemini to give advice and visualise plans from emergency funds to investing.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[Warp] Expedited internship / full time interview process + Cash” among 112 submissions.
Visualises plans rather than listing numbers.

lessons: A picture of the plan beats a table.
